repo_notes.content: HCOMM is the communication base library beneath HCCL (repo cann/hccl). It owns communication domains, physical topology parsing, PhyTopo/RankGraph construction, endpoints, links and resources. Core paths: src/coll_communicator_mgr/rank_graph/topo_info/ (EdgeInfo/TopoInfo: topo.json edge parsing with mandatory net_layer 0..7, protocols, link_type PEER2PEER/PEER2NET, ports, topo_type CLOS/1DMESH/2DMESH/A3_SERVER/A2_AX_SERVER), rank_table_info/ (RankTableInfo: version 2.0, contiguous rank_id, per-netLayer RankLevelInfo with netInstId/addr/ports/planes), phy_topo_builder/ (topo.json -> layered bidirectional PhyTopo, P2P reverse edges created in CreateGraph), rank_graph/ (NetInstance/TopoInstance/ConnInterface/RankGraph, V1/V2 adapters), rank_graph_builder/ (Build/RecoverBuild chain: CheckMyRankInRankTable -> BuildFromRankTable -> AddFabricInfo -> BuildPeer2PeerLinks -> SetEndpointDesc; P2N requires rank-port and link-port intersection). Cross-SO bridge (rank_graph_builder_bridge/provider) returns RankGraph+RankTableInfo+TopoInfo as one snapshot, maps HcclException to HcclResult codes, and pins destructors to hcomm-side deleters. HCCL queries the graph via HcclRankGraphGet* (GetLayers/GetLinks/GetTopoInstsByLayer/GetRanksByTopoInst/GetTopoType/GetInstSizeListByLayer/GetEndpoint*). Base primitives live in src/base_comm/primitives/api_c_adpt/ dispatched per device/thread type (A5 -> StreamLite/transport-lite). src/legacy/ascend950, framework/, service/ hold compatibility entries; PreemptPortManager is reused from legacy by hcomm.
repo_notes.author: hccl-skills workspace

repo_notes.content: Version boundary: master follows CANN releases; rank_graph/phy_topo once reverted a change that ignored the net_layer field in topo.json, so net_layer must be treated as a mandatory field in the current implementation. Document tag/commit when behavior is tag-specific. The sibling repo cann/hccl contains the operator/algorithm layer that consumes these APIs; cross-reference instead of duplicating.
